description: This file defines the CashPaymentMethod class for the Goteo payment system, implementing a manual payment method used primarily for administrative purposes.

classes.name: CashPaymentMethod
classes.description: A payment method class for handling cash payments in the Goteo system, utilizing a manual gateway.

methods.name: getGatewayName
methods.description: Returns the name of the payment gateway, which is 'Manual' for this method.

methods.name: isPublic
methods.description: Determines if the payment method is publicly available; returns false indicating it's only for administrative use.
